review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 【材料合作方向】(可选) 1. 潜伏性固化剂开发: 用于单组份材料耐高温存储:环氧、EPDM、聚烯烃等体系，在交联剂存在混合体系里70°C存储90天后，产品保持初始状态，烘烤后功能正常 2. 环保型发泡剂与固化剂开发: 实现膨胀或固化后低气味(80°C气味等级3.0; VDA270标准;规避因含元素S、N等元素而产生的不良气味);热稳定性好，60°C14天不预分解，不反应 3. 功能泡沫开发A: 室温发泡成型;密度0.2g/Cm3;压缩强度10MPa，满足动态压溃80%性能不损失，泡沫不碎； 功能泡沫开发B: 注塑成型;固化温度120~200°C;固化后密度0.3~0.6g/cm3，拉伸强度≥30MPa，断裂伸长率≥20%;满足动态压溃80%性能不损失，泡沫不碎 4. 增韧树脂开发: 确保单组分、双组份胶粘剂满足低温-40°C、30min抗冲击性能≥40N/mm;满足≥500万次疲劳 5. 高阻尼宽温域树脂开发: 应用与产品中(加工湿度60-120°C)，材料阻尼性能提升(环境温度-20~60°C)损耗因子DMA20.8;复合损耗因子20.3;通过分子结构调整可满足不同特定需求 【工作内容】 1、负责汽车用高分子新材料的配方研发与性能优化，提升材料耐温及力学指标； 2、主导实验室小试至中试放大工艺验证，解决量产过程中的材料稳定性问题； 3、对接俄罗斯高校科研团队，开展前沿技术合作及联合攻关项目落地执行； 4、撰写研发测试报告与技术文档，建立材料数据库并推动新技术在车规件应用。 【任职要求】 1、高分子材料、化学工程或相关专业硕士及以上学历，具备俄语听说读写能力； 2、熟悉汽车改性塑料、橡胶等高分子材料特性，掌握流变学及热分析测试技术； 3、拥有3年以上高分子研发经验，有海外高校合作或跨国项目经验者优先； 4、具备优秀的跨文化沟通能力和逻辑思维能力，能适应短期出差及高强度工作。

review_candidates.title: Welder / Fabricator (on-site)
review_candidates.company: Alternative Heat Ltd
review_candidates.description: Department: Contracts Location: Frankfurt Description Team Overview: The Welder / Fabricator will form part of Alternative Heat's European Site Delivery Team, supporting the installation and completion of mechanical building services projects throughout the Rhine-Main region and wider Germany as required. The role works closely with Regional Delivery Leads, Mechanical Supervisors, Pipefitters and Commissioning personnel to ensure all fabricated and welded pipework systems are completed safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards. Role Overview: The Welder / Fabricator is responsible for carrying out high-quality welding and fabrication activities on chilled water and mechanical services pipework systems across construction, energy centre and industrial projects. Working predominantly on site, the successful candidate will produce final pipework connections, site modifications and fabricated spools to ensure successful installation and project completion. The primary focus of the role is TIG welding of carbon steel pipework, with additional welding activities on stainless steel systems as required. The role requires a highly skilled welder with recognised EU and German welding qualifications, extensive experience across common welding processes and a strong understanding of site-based fabrication and installation activities. During periods where welding activities are reduced, the Welder / Fabricator will support mechanical installation teams with pipework assembly, equipment installation and general mechanical fitting duties to assist project delivery. What You'll be Doing • Carry out TIG welding on carbon steel pipework systems, which will represent the majority of welding activities. • Perform welding on stainless steel pipework systems as required by project specifications. • Complete final site welds, tie-ins and connections to prefabricated chilled water and mechanical services pipework. • Fabricate, modify and adapt pipe spools to suit site conditions and installation requirements. • Read and interpret isometric drawings, fabrication drawings and welding documentation. • Ensure all welding activities comply with approved WPS, project quality requirements and relevant EU/German standards. • Maintain valid EN ISO 9606 welding qualifications and produce work to a consistently high standard. • Carry out visual inspection of welds and support testing, quality inspections and project handovers. • Maintain a safe working environment and comply with all company and site health, safety and environmental requirements. • Support pipefitters and mechanical installation teams with mechanical installations, equipment fitting and pipework assembly when welding work is not required. What You Need to Have • Valid EN ISO 9606 welding certification(s) • Demonstrable experience carrying out TIG welding on carbon steel pipework systems. • Experience welding stainless steel pipework systems. • Proven experience in site-based fabrication, spool modification and final pipework connections. • Experience working on chilled water, heating or mechanical building services installations. • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication drawings and isometric pipework drawings. • Knowledge of welding procedures, quality requirements and inspection standards. • Familiarity with relevant EU and German welding regulations and standards. • Strong understanding of construction site health and safety requirements. • Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality workmanship. • English language skills (written and spoken) are mandatory. • Full right to work in Germany. • Valid driving license.
